label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Use a P.S. for an extra punch
body: A P.S. at the end of your email is often read, making it a great spot for a quick reminder or a friendly personal note.
caption:
Ever notice how your eyes often jump to the P.S. at the end of a letter? It works the same way in emails! This little section is a fantastic, low-pressure spot to reinforce your main call to action, share a quick tip, or add a personal touch. It’s an easy way to grab attention one last time without being pushy. Give it a try in your next email!
